headline: Record quarter on cloud and AI demand, bullish outlook
summary_short: Sanmina's quarter ended October 3, 2026 delivered revenue of $3.86 billion, non-GAAP EPS of $4.43 and GAAP EPS of $2.14, with a fiscal 2027 revenue outlook of $17.5-$19.5 billion.
summary_long: Non-GAAP operating margin was 9.0% and GAAP operating margin 6.0%. Operating cash flow was $242 million and free cash flow $83 million; the company repurchased $154 million of stock in the quarter. For fiscal 2026, revenue was $14.53 billion, up 79%, with non-GAAP EPS of $13.28. Guidance for Q1 FY2027: revenue $3.8-$4.1 billion, non-GAAP EPS $3.50-$3.85. Full-year FY2027: revenue $17.5-$19.5 billion, non-GAAP EPS $15.50-$17.50.
confidence_notes: Period label follows the shard (FY2026 Q3), but the release covers Sanmina's fourth fiscal quarter ended October 3, 2026 (fiscal-offset labelling issue). EPS deltas use shard Yahoo-chart values (4.43 vs 1.72 prior quarter, 1.28 a year ago), which match the release's non-GAAP EPS. Release gives no q/q revenue comparison, so none is shown. Source link was found by WebSearch (no filing link on the shard).

drivers.explanation: CEO attributed results to disciplined execution and diversification, plus integration of ZT Systems that strengthened the Cloud and AI Infrastructure end market.
Fiscal-year revenue grew 79%, with broad-based growth across end markets and double-digit growth in the core business plus ZT Systems.
Management expects demand to stay strong into fiscal 2027, projecting about 27% revenue growth at the outlook midpoint.
